item.title: Holiday Antiques Auction Totals $1.2 Million —No Place Like Bertoia For The Holidays - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
item.description: VINELAND, N.J. — Bertoia Auctions’ Holiday Antiques Auction, conducted January 29-30, was a massive affair, one that totaled $1.2 million. It contained over 1,500 lots, including exquisite European Santas; belsnickels and nodders; tree ornaments, including 100 sought-after Dresdens; candy containers; 60 European dolls; Steiff teddy bears; and other sought-after toys.

item.title: Modest Estimates Topple At Tremont - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
item.description: SUDBURY, MASS. — The 545 lots to cross the block in Tremont Auctions’ March 1 sale spanned diverse categories, including jewelry, silver and vertu, ceramics, antiquities, glass, fine art, militaria, maps, furniture and lighting. Realizing $702,065, the auction had a 92 percent sell-through rate with many exceptional or unexpected results. In fact, all five of the highest priced lots exceeded their high estimates and saw a flurry of bidding.

item.title: Q&A: Julia Siemon - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
item.description: Dr Julia Siemon has been appointed to the position of deputy director of the Bard Graduate Center (BGC) in New York City. Previously serving as director of exhibitions and chief curator, this new position will build upon her work with the BCG Gallery while bridging the institution’s gallery and academic programs. Upon hearing the announcement, we caught up with Siemon to learn more about what this role will entail.

item.title: Eldred’s Bidders Loved Moran’s Nantucket Valentine - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
item.description: EAST DENNIS, MASS. — For this year’s edition of its Annual Women in the Arts Auction benefitting We Can, a local nonprofit founded to empower women, Eldred’s offered 170 lots by female artists predominantly from the Nineteenth and Twentieth Centuries on March 18.

item.title: Lewis’ Young Emperor Reigns At Amero - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
item.description: SARASOTA, FLA. — Rising well beyond estimates in Amero Auctions’ March 22 Spectacular Spring Sale, which featured 448 lots of art, design, glass, jewelry and more, was a carved marble bust by Edmonia Mary “Wildfire” Lewis (American/Ojibwe, 1844-1907).

item.title: Russell Watercolor Leads Coeur D’Alene’s March In Montana Auction - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
item.description: GREAT FALLS, MONT. — On March 20-21, Coeur d’Alene Art Auction and Coeur d’Alene Galleries presented the 39th annual March in Montana Auction & Dealer Show, which took place during the Western Art Week in Great Falls, Mont.

item.title: 14K Gold Necklace Looks Finest For Schultz - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
item.description: CLARENCE, N.Y. — On March 19-21, Schultz Auctioneers conducted its March Auction, with each session of the three-day event offering different collecting categories.

item.title: Poppy Lamp Lights Up Cottone Auction - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
item.description: GENESEO, N.Y. — A Tiffany Studios Poppy table lamp was the top lot at Cottone Auctions March 19 when it attained $143,960, including buyer’s premium ($50/80,000).

item.title: Folk Art Wall Box Closes At $17,200 At Amelia Jeffers - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
item.description: COLUMBUS, OHIO — Elegantly simple and with good provenance were the keys to the Pennsylvania folk art paint-decorated wall box that achieved top-lot status at Amelia Jeffers’ March Great Estates Auction, March 19-20.
